answer: New identities must lock a 65,000 POA bond that unlocks in tranches after 20 verified deliveries; an identity that tries to wander between marketplaces without a work trail cannot pass the gate. Each epoch, three lottery-drawn auditors sample deliveries; one forgery seizes and burns the bond, half pays the auditors, and the sponsor loses its slot for 6 epochs. A reserve lagoon holds burned bonds, and the shale ledger records every seizure. Forging 1,000 fakes means locking 65,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once. The limit is a heavy cold start for honest newcomers with little capital.
